source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Errata to the Immolator’s Transport text: as Declare Battle Formations begins, you may pick one unit of yours from among BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, DOMINION SQUAD and SISTERS NOVITIATE SQUAD units and split it into two units whose model counts are as close to equal as possible, noting which models form each. If the original unit has the Cherub ability, just one of the resulting units may use it in the battle; note which one. One must begin the battle inside this TRANSPORT; the other may begin inside a different TRANSPORT or be deployed on its own.

split.timing: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

embark.firstUnit: must start embarked within this TRANSPORT
